entries.message: This update includes automate Up Next provider sync and show Jellyfin in Up Next Watch now.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Up Next provider rails now sync automatically when the queue changes.
Show Jellyfin alongside Plex and Emby in dashboard Up Next Watch now links.
Keep provider link selection aligned with the supported connected media apps.
Document queue-triggered provider updates and cover the complete app set in regression tests.
